# Component reference

Every component is exported from `@cherry-design-system/react` and styled by `@cherry-design-system/react/styles.css` (import it once). Props below are the ones cherry adds; each component also accepts the attributes of the element it renders (listed as "plus all `<el>` attributes") and forwards its ref. Allowed values are exact: a value outside the list renders unstyled.

- [Actions](#actions): Button, ConfirmButton, IconButton, Link
- [Forms](#forms): AvatarDropzone, Checkbox, Combobox, Dropzone, Field, FileItem, Input, NumberField, OTPInput, OTPSlot, Password, Radio, RadioGroup, Range, Select, Tag, Textarea, ThemeToggle, Toggle, ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem
- [Pickers](#pickers): Calendar, DatePicker, DateTimePicker, TimePicker
- [Navigation](#navigation): Breadcrumb, NavPill, NavItem, Pagination, Sidebar, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem, Stepper, Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel
- [Overlays](#overlays): Menu, MenuGroup, MenuSeparator, MenuItem, Modal, ModalBody, ModalFooter, Popover, SearchDialog, SearchGroup, SearchResult, Sheet, SheetBody, SheetFooter, Tooltip
- [Feedback](#feedback): Banner, Callout, EmptyState, Progress, Skeleton, Spinner, Toaster
- [Data display](#data-display): Avatar, AvatarGroup, Badge, Kbd, StatCard, Table
- [Content](#content): Accordion, AccordionItem, Card, CardIcon, CardTitle, CodeBlock, InlineCode, Prose, Separator, Snippet
- [Layout](#layout): Container, Flex, Stack, Grid, Col
- [Chat](#chat): ChatInput, ChatMessage, ChatPanel, ChatMessageList, ChatLauncher, ChatSources, ChatSource, ChatSuggestions, ChatSuggestion, ChatTyping

## Actions

### Button

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

A button. No client JS: safe in React Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"accent" \| "primary" \| "outline" \| "secondary" \| "ghost"` | "primary" | Visual style. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | "md" | 32 / 36 / 44 px. |
| `leadingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label (e.g. a lucide icon element). |
| `trailingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon after the label. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  | Stretch to the container width. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks. |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Native `<button>` with a visible focus ring. `loading` sets aria-busy and keeps the label readable. For icon-only actions use IconButton.

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" leadingIcon={<Plus />}>New project</Button>
<Button variant="outline" loading>Saving</Button>
```

### ConfirmButton

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Two-step destructive action. The first click widens the control and reveals a confirm / cancel pair inside it (the default trash icon lifts its lid); it closes again on cancel, Escape, or after `resetAfter` ms.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onConfirm` (required) | `() => void` |  | Runs when the second step is confirmed. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` |  | Runs when the confirm step closes without confirming. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | a trash can | Trigger icon. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | "Delete" | Accessible name of the trigger. |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | "Confirm" | Name of the confirm button. |
| `cancelLabel` | `string` | "Cancel" | Name of the cancel button. |
| `resetAfter` | `number` |  | Milliseconds before the confirm step closes by itself; 0 keeps it. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `wrapperClassName` | `string` |  | Class for the outer wrapper (className goes to the trigger). |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** The trigger has aria-expanded. Opening moves focus to Confirm; Cancel, Escape, leaving the control or `resetAfter` closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Give it a specific `aria-label` ("Delete report.pdf").

```tsx
<ConfirmButton aria-label="Delete report.pdf" onConfirm={() => remove(id)} />
```

### IconButton

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Square icon-only button. Pass aria-pressed for toggle behaviour.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` |  | Required: icon-only buttons need an accessible name. |
| `icon` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The icon element (e.g. `<X />`). |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "ghost" \| "solid"` |  |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** `aria-label` is required: the glyph is hidden from screen readers. As a toggle, pass `aria-pressed`.

```tsx
<IconButton aria-label="Search" icon={<Search />} variant="ghost" />
```

### Link

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Text link. The underline sweeps in on hover, the external arrow nudges toward its target, and focus draws a ring offset from the text. Router links can take the same look with className="cherry-link" plus data-variant. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "muted"` | "default" | default: underlined text color; muted: gray until hovered. |
| `external` | `boolean` |  | Opens in a new tab (rel="noopener noreferrer") and shows an arrow icon. |
| `externalLabel` | `string` | "(opens in a new tab)" | Spoken after the text of an external link. |

Plus all `<a>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Underlined so it is not identified by color alone. `external` opens a new tab and adds `externalLabel` ("opens in a new tab") to the name.

```tsx
<Link href="/docs">Read the docs</Link>
<Link href="https://example.com" external>Example site</Link>
```

## Forms

### AvatarDropzone

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Round profile-picture picker: click, keyboard or drop. The preview scales in, the remove badge pops, and removing fades the picture out before the empty state returns.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | "md" | 64 / 96 / 128 px. |
| `defaultSrc` | `string` |  | Picture shown before anything is picked (an existing avatar URL). |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | an image-plus glyph | Icon shown while empty. |
| `maxBytes` | `number` |  | Maximum file size, in bytes. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` | "Upload profile picture" | Accessible name of the picker. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | "Remove profile picture" | Accessible name of the remove button. |
| `onFileChange` | `(file: File \| null) => void` |  | The picked picture, or null once it is removed. |
| `onFileRejected` | `(rejection: DropzoneRejection) => void` |  | A file refused for its type or size. |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A labelled native file input (`label`); the remove button is labelled (`removeLabel`).

```tsx
<AvatarDropzone label="Upload profile picture" onFileChange={setAvatar} />
```

### Checkbox

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Checkbox on a native `<input type="checkbox">`: it submits, resets and handles keyboard and assistive tech natively. The checkmark stroke draws in; `indeterminate` shows a dash.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label. Omit only when an aria-label is given. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | "md" | 16 / 18 / 20 px box. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Error state; set automatically inside a `<Field error>`. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` |  | Mixed state (a dash). Announced as "mixed"; cleared by the next click. |
| `wrapperClassName` | `string` |  | Class for the outer `<label>` (className goes to the `<input>`). |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Native checkbox: Space toggles, the label is clickable, `indeterminate` is announced as mixed.

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Accept the terms" required />
```

### Combobox

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Text input with a filterable listbox (ARIA combobox pattern). The list is a native `popover`, placed with CSS anchor positioning; it scales and fades in and out. Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` (required) | `ReadonlyArray<ComboboxOption \| string>` |  | The choices; plain strings are both value and label. |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  | Controlled selected value (null = none). |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` |  |  |
| `onInputChange` | `(text: string) => void` |  | Called with the typed text on every keystroke. |
| `filter` | `(option: ComboboxOption, query: string) => boolean` | a case-insensitive "contains" | Custom matcher. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Error state; set automatically inside a `<Field error>`. |
| `emptyMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown when nothing matches. |
| `emptyHint` | `ReactNode` |  | Second line under emptyMessage. |
| `resultsLabel` | `(count: number) => string` |  | Live-region text for the match count (translate here). |
| `toggleLabel` | `string` | "Show options" | Name of the chevron button. |
| `wrapperClassName` | `string` |  | Class for the outer wrapper (className goes to the `<input>`). |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Combobox + listbox pattern: Up/Down highlight options (aria-activedescendant), Enter selects, Escape closes; the result count is announced (`resultsLabel`).

```tsx
<Field label="Framework">
  <Combobox options={["Next.js", "Remix", "Astro"]} placeholder="Select a framework" />
</Field>
```

### Dropzone

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Drag-and-drop file area around a real file input: the input is visually hidden but focusable, so Tab + Enter/Space open the native picker, forms submit the files (dropped ones included) and it works inside `<Field>`. Pair it with `<FileItem>` to list what was added.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | `ReactNode` | "Click to upload" | Bold first words of the prompt. |
| `browse` | `ReactNode` | "or drag and drop" | Rest of the prompt line. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` |  | Small line under the prompt (accepted types, limits). |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | an upload glyph | Icon in the tile. |
| `inline` | `boolean` |  | Compact horizontal layout that sits in a form row. |
| `maxBytes` | `number` |  | Maximum size per file, in bytes. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` |  | Maximum files accepted from one pick or drop. With `multiple` unset, 1. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onFilesAdded` | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Accepted files from a pick or a drop. |
| `onFilesRejected` | `(rejections: DropzoneRejection[]) => void` |  | Files refused for their type, size or count. |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

Also exported: `matchesAccept` (Matches a file against an `accept` string (".pdf,image/*,text/plain"), mirroring the native picker's filter for dropped files).

**Accessibility:** A native file input: Tab to it, Enter/Space opens the picker. The hint states the limits; rejected files set aria-invalid.

```tsx
<Dropzone accept="image/*" maxBytes={10_000_000} hint="PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB" onFilesAdded={upload} />
```

### Field

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Label + control + hint/error, wired for assistive tech.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` |  | Helper text under the control. Hidden while an error shows. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` |  | Error message. Marks the control aria-invalid and replaces the hint. |
| `id` | `string` |  | The control's id (generated when omitted). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

Also exported: `FieldContext`; `useFieldControl` (Props a control inside `<Field>` should spread (id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, disabled, required). Explicit props on the control win).

**Accessibility:** Links the label to the control and the hint/error through aria-describedby; `error` sets aria-invalid on the control. `required` uses the native required attribute, not just the asterisk. Works with Input, Textarea, Select, Password, NumberField, Combobox, OTPInput and the pickers.

```tsx
<Field label="Username" required error={errors.username}>
  <Input name="username" />
</Field>
```

### FileItem

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

One uploaded (or uploading) file: icon tile, name, size, progress or status, and a remove button. Rows slide in, the progress fill eases, the glyph pops on each status change, an error shakes once, and a removed row collapses out before `onRemove` runs.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | `string` |  | File name. |
| `bytes` | `number` |  | File size in bytes (formatted as "2.4 MB"). |
| `status` | `"uploading" \| "complete" \| "error"` | "complete" |  |
| `progress` | `number` |  | Upload progress, 0-100, shown while uploading. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | "Upload failed" | Error message shown in the error state. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | a document glyph (a warning on error) | Icon in the tile. |
| `completeLabel` | `ReactNode` | "Uploaded" | Text after the size when complete. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | "Remove {name}" | Accessible name of the remove button. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  | Shows the remove button. Runs after the row has animated out. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

Also exported: `formatBytes` (2_400_000 -> "2.4 MB" (1000-based, like file managers)).

**Accessibility:** Upload progress is a labelled progressbar, errors are announced as alerts, the remove button is labelled.

```tsx
<FileItem name="brand.pdf" bytes={2_400_000} status="uploading" progress={64} onRemove={cancel} />
```

### Input

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Text input. The ref and every native prop go to the `<input>`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

```tsx
</Field>
```

### NumberField

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Numeric input with decrement / increment buttons (role="spinbutton"). Arrow keys step, PageUp/PageDown take large steps, Home/End jump to min/max. Typed text commits on blur or Enter, clamped and snapped.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | Controlled value (null = empty). |
| `defaultValue` | `number \| null` |  | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number \| null) => void` |  |  |
| `min` | `number` |  |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `step` | `number` | 1 | Arrow / button increment. |
| `largeStep` | `number` | step * 10 | PageUp / PageDown increment. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Error state; set automatically inside a `<Field error>`. |
| `decrementLabel` | `string` |  | Names of the stepper buttons (translate here). |
| `incrementLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `wrapperClassName` | `string` |  | Class for the outer wrapper (className goes to the `<input>`). |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=spinbutton: Up/Down step, PageUp/PageDown use `largeStep`, Home/End go to min/max. The steppers are labelled buttons (`decrementLabel`, `incrementLabel`).

```tsx
<Field label="Guests">
  <NumberField min={1} max={8} defaultValue={2} />
</Field>
```

### OTPInput, OTPSlot

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**OTPInput**: One-time code input: N single-character slots. Typing advances, Backspace goes back, arrows move, and pasting (or SMS autofill) fills every slot.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `number` | 6 | Number of slots. |
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called once every slot is filled. |
| `mode` | `"numeric" \| "alphanumeric"` | "numeric" | Accepted characters. |
| `separator` | `boolean` |  | Show a divider between the two halves. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Error state; set automatically inside a `<Field error>`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name (the joined code is submitted). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `slotLabel` | `(index: number, length: number) => string` | "Character {n} of {length}" | Accessible name per slot. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**OTPSlot**: One character cell of an `<OTPInput>`: a single-character input with a blinking caret while it is focused and empty. Exported for custom layouts; `<OTPInput>` renders these for you.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | The slot's character ("" when empty). |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A named group; each slot is labelled "Character n of length" (`slotLabel`). Typing advances, Backspace goes back, arrows/Home/End move, paste fills every slot.

```tsx
<Field label="Verification code">
  <OTPInput length={6} separator onComplete={verify} />
</Field>
```

| `name` | `string` |  | Shared input name (generated when omitted). |

System / Light / Dark segmented switch (a radio group, arrow keys move).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` |  |  |
| `labels` | `Partial<Record<ColorModePreference, string>>` |  | Labels for the three options (translate here). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | "Color mode" | Group label. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A radiogroup: arrow keys change the mode; each option is labelled (System, Light, Dark; override with `labels`).

```tsx
<ThemeToggle />
```

### Toggle

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

On/off switch built on a native checkbox with role="switch": it submits and resets with forms, and works without client JS (uncontrolled), so it renders in Server Components. Use `checked` + `onChange` for controlled use.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label. Omit only when an aria-label is given. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |

Plus all `<input>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=switch: Space toggles and on/off is announced. The `label` names it.

```tsx
<Toggle label="Email notifications" defaultChecked />
```

### ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**ToggleGroup**: Segmented control. `type="single"` is a radiogroup whose selected pill slides between items; `type="multiple"` is a group of pressed buttons. Arrow keys, Home and End move between items.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` |  | One value at a time (a radio group). The default. Any number of values (toggle buttons with aria-pressed). |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  |  |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

**ToggleGroupItem**: One option of a ToggleGroup. Icon-only items need an aria-label.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  |  |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** `type="single"` is a radiogroup (arrows, Home/End move and select); `type="multiple"` is toggle buttons with aria-pressed. Label icon-only items and name the group.

```tsx
<ToggleGroup type="single" defaultValue="week" aria-label="Range">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="day">Day</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="week">Week</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>
```

## Pickers

### Calendar

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Month grid (role="grid"). Arrows move by day/week, PageUp/PageDown by month (with Shift by year), Home/End to the week's edges. Single date or range selection; changing month slides the grid.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `"single" \| "range"` |  |  |
| `value` | `Date \| null` |  |  |
| `defaultValue` | `Date \| null` |  |  |
| `onChange` | `(date: Date) => void` |  |  |
| `month` | `Date` |  | Visible month (controlled). Any day inside the month works. |
| `defaultMonth` | `Date` | the selection or today | Initial visible month (uncontrolled). |
| `onMonthChange` | `(month: Date) => void` |  |  |
| `min` | `Date` |  | Earliest selectable day. |
| `max` | `Date` |  | Latest selectable day. |
| `isDateDisabled` | `(date: Date) => boolean` |  | Extra rule for unavailable days (weekends, booked dates...). |
| `locale` | `string` | the runtime's | BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names. |
| `weekStartsOn` | `Weekday` | the locale's first day | 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. |
| `today` | `Date` |  | Override "today" (tests, server rendering in another time zone). |
| `labels` | `CalendarLabels` |  | Button labels (translate here). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  | Fill the container: the seven day columns share its width. |

**Accessibility:** role=grid with one tab stop. Arrows move by day/week, PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift for a year), Home/End to the week's start/end. Today is aria-current=date and month changes are announced.

```tsx
<Calendar locale="en-US" defaultValue={new Date()} onChange={setDate} fullWidth />
```

## Navigation

### Breadcrumb

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Breadcrumb trail: `<nav>` with an ordered list, the last entry marked aria-current="page". No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `BreadcrumbEntry[]` |  | Trail from the root to the current page (the last entry). |
| `separator` | `"chevron" \| "slash"` | `chevron` | Glyph between entries. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | "Breadcrumb" | Names the landmark. |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A nav landmark ("Breadcrumb"); the current page is aria-current=page; separators are hidden; links are 24px targets.

```tsx
<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Docs", href: "/docs" }, { label: "Combobox" }]} />
```

### NavPill, NavItem

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**NavPill**: Top navigation pill: a `<nav>` holding NavItems. A highlight slides to the item with aria-current="page" whenever it changes (route change, resize). Without JS the current item paints its own static highlight.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | "Main" | Names the navigation landmark. |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

**NavItem**: One link in a NavPill (renders its own `<li>`). No client JS: the active state is plain `aria-current`, so it renders in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | Marks the current page (sets aria-current="page"). |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional leading icon. |

Plus all `<a>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A nav landmark (name it with aria-label); the active link is aria-current=page. Dividers are decorative and hide beside the active item.

```tsx
<NavPill aria-label="Main">
  <NavItem href="/" active>Home</NavItem>
  <NavItem href="/docs">Docs</NavItem>
</NavPill>
```

### Pagination

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Pagination. With `getHref` every control is a plain link (no client JS); with `onPageChange` they are buttons. Unavailable steps are aria-disabled, the current page has aria-current="page".

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (required) | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based. |
| `totalPages` (required) | `number` |  | Number of pages. |
| `getHref` | `(page: number) => string` |  | Builds the link for a page: zero-JS pagination (Server Components). |
| `onPageChange` | `(page: number) => void` |  | Called with the target page; renders buttons when `getHref` is absent. |
| `variant` | `"full" \| "compact"` |  | `full` (numbered pages) or `compact` ("Page 3 of 10"). |
| `siblings` | `number` | 1 | Pages shown either side of the current one. |
| `labels` | `PaginationLabels` |  |  |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

Also exported: `paginationRange` (Page numbers to show: always the first and last `boundaries` pages and `siblings` pages around the current one, with "ellipsis" for each gap. The list keeps a constant length so the control does not jump in width).

**Accessibility:** A nav landmark; give each one a distinct name (`labels.nav`) when a page has two. The current page is aria-current=page; Previous/Next are labelled. `getHref` renders links and needs no JS.

```tsx
<Pagination page={page} totalPages={10} onPageChange={setPage} />
```

### Sidebar, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

**Sidebar**: App sidebar: an `<aside>` with header, a `<nav>` of SidebarGroups, and a footer. No client JS: collapsible groups are native `<details>`, the active item is plain `aria-current`, and `collapsed` is a prop you drive.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `ReactNode` |  | Top slot: logo, workspace switcher, collapse button. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` |  | Bottom slot: account, settings. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` |  | Icon rail: labels, badges and group titles hide, width eases to 64px. |
| `navLabel` | `string` | "Sidebar" | Names the navigation landmark. |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

**SidebarGroup**: A titled list of SidebarItems, optionally collapsible via `<details>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Group title (rendered as an eyebrow). Optional. |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` |  | Makes the title a native disclosure that folds the group. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | open | Initial state of a collapsible group. |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

**SidebarItem**: One sidebar entry, in its own `<li>`. With `href` it is a link, without it a button (pass `onClick` from a Client Component).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon (e.g. a lucide element). Stays visible when collapsed. |
| `badge` | `ReactNode` |  | Trailing count or Badge. |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | Marks the current item (aria-current="page" on links, "true" on buttons). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Only for the button form (no `href`). |

Plus all `<a>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A nav landmark (`navLabel`); the active item is aria-current. Collapsed, items keep their names for screen readers and group titles leave the tab order.

```tsx
<Sidebar collapsed={collapsed} navLabel="Main">
  <SidebarGroup label="Workspace">
    <SidebarItem href="/" icon={<House />} active>Home</SidebarItem>
    <SidebarItem href="/team" icon={<Users />}>Team</SidebarItem>
  </SidebarGroup>
</Sidebar>
```

### Stepper

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Progress through a multi-step flow, as an ordered list. The current step has aria-current="step"; each step also announces its state. Connectors fill as steps complete. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` (required) | `StepperStep[]` |  |  |
| `current` (required) | `number` |  | Index (0-based) of the current step; earlier steps are complete. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | `horizontal` |  |
| `labels` | `Partial<Record<StepperState, string>>` |  | Screen-reader words for each state (translate here). |

Plus all `<ol>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** The current step is aria-current=step; completed steps say so in text (`labels`), not only with the check.

```tsx
<Stepper steps={[{ label: "Account" }, { label: "Workspace" }, { label: "Invite" }]} current={1} aria-label="Setup" />
```

### Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**Tabs**: Tabs: a `TabList` of `Tab`s plus one `TabPanel` per tab, matched by `value`. Arrow keys move and select (automatic activation), Home/End jump to the ends; the indicator slides to the selected tab.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  | Selected tab (controlled). Pair with `onValueChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | the first enabled tab after mount | Initially selected tab (uncontrolled). set it to have the selection in server-rendered HTML. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `variant` | `"pill" \| "underline"` |  | `pill` (raised tab in a muted track, default) or `underline`. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**TabList**: (no description)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Name the tab list (or use aria-labelledby). |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Tab**: (no description)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | Matches the `value` of its TabPanel. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional leading icon. |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**TabPanel**: Content for one tab. Inactive panels stay mounted but hidden.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  |  |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** tablist / tab / tabpanel: Left/Right move and select, Home/End jump; one tab stop; each panel is labelled by its tab. Name the TabList.

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <TabList aria-label="Project">
    <Tab value="overview">Overview</Tab>
    <Tab value="settings">Settings</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value="overview">…</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="settings">…</TabPanel>
</Tabs>
```

## Overlays

### Menu, MenuGroup, MenuSeparator

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**Menu**: A menu button: the trigger opens a `popover` menu (role="menu") anchored to it. Arrow keys, Home/End and typeahead move between items, Escape or Tab close it and focus returns to the trigger. It scales and fades in from the trigger's side, and back out, in CSS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` (required) | `ReactElement<TriggerProps>` |  | The button that opens the menu (a `<Button>` or `<IconButton>`). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | `<MenuItem>`, `<MenuGroup>` and `<MenuSeparator>` elements. |
| `placement` | `"left" \| "right" \| "top" \| "bottom"` | "bottom" | Side of the trigger. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end" \| "center"` | "start" | Alignment along that side. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the menu opens or closes. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**MenuGroup**: A labelled run of menu items (role="group").

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Small all-caps heading over the group; names it for assistive tech. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**MenuSeparator**: A divider between groups of menu items.

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

Also exported: `useMenu`.

**Accessibility:** role=menu: opening focuses the first item, Up/Down and Home/End move, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Shortcut hints are hidden from screen readers.

```tsx
<Menu trigger={<Button variant="outline">Actions</Button>}>
  <MenuGroup label="Project">
    <MenuItem icon={<Copy />} shortcut="⌘C" onClick={copyLink}>Copy link</MenuItem>
  </MenuGroup>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem variant="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete project</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

### MenuItem

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

One action in a `<Menu>` (role="menuitem"). Choosing it runs onClick, then closes the menu unless onClick called preventDefault(). Disabled items stay visible but are skipped by the keyboard and do nothing.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label (e.g. `<Copy />`). |
| `shortcut` | `ReactNode` |  | Visual shortcut hint at the end (e.g. "⌘C"); pass aria-keyshortcuts for assistive tech. |
| `variant` | `"danger" \| "default"` | "default" | "danger" for destructive actions. |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=menuitem. Name destructive items clearly ("Delete project"): the danger tint is not announced.

```tsx
<MenuItem icon={<Trash />} variant="danger">Delete project</MenuItem>
```

### Modal, ModalBody, ModalFooter

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**Modal**: A modal dialog on the native `<dialog>` (showModal): focus trap, top layer, inert page and Escape come from the platform. Fades and scales in over a fading backdrop; the exit plays in CSS. Compose the content with `<ModalBody>` and `<ModalFooter>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. |
| `onClose` (required) | `() => void` |  | Asked on Escape, a backdrop click or the close button. Set `open` to false here. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Heading; also the dialog's accessible name. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Line under the title; wired as the accessible description. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | "md" | 400 / 480 / 640 px wide. |
| `hideClose` | `boolean` |  | Hide the close button in the header. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | "Close" | Accessible name of the close button. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | true | Escape and backdrop clicks close it. |

Plus all `<dialog>` attributes.

**ModalBody**: Scrolling content area of a `<Modal>`.

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**ModalFooter**: Action row at the bottom of a `<Modal>`, aligned to the end.

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Native `<dialog>` (modal): the page behind is inert, focus moves in and stays in, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger. `title` names it and `description` describes it.

```tsx
<Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Delete project?" description="This cannot be undone.">
  <ModalFooter>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="accent" onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </ModalFooter>
</Modal>
```

### Popover

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

A floating panel on the native `popover` attribute, positioned against its trigger with CSS anchor positioning. No client JS: point a button at it with `popoverTarget={id}` (the invoker is the anchor) and the browser opens, closes and light-dismisses it. It scales and fades in from the trigger's side, and back out.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` (required) | `string` |  | Required: the trigger points at it with `popoverTarget={id}`. |
| `placement` | `"left" \| "right" \| "top" \| "bottom"` | "bottom" | Side of the trigger it opens on. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end" \| "center"` | "center" | Alignment along that side. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Heading; also the popover's accessible name. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons at the bottom, aligned to the end. |
| `mode` | `"auto" \| "manual"` |  | "auto" (default) closes on Escape, an outside click or another popover opening; "manual" only closes when told to. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Native popover (non-modal): Escape and outside clicks close it and focus returns to the trigger. With `title` it is a labelled dialog. Open it with `popoverTarget` on a button, no JS needed.

```tsx
<Button variant="outline" popoverTarget="share">Share</Button>
<Popover id="share" title="Share preview">Anyone with the link can view it.</Popover>
```

### SearchDialog, SearchGroup

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**SearchDialog**: Command-palette search on a native `<dialog>`: an input (role="combobox") over a listbox of results. Arrow keys move the highlight (aria-activedescendant, focus stays in the input), Enter selects it, Escape closes. Opens and closes like `<Modal>`: fade + scale over a fading backdrop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. |
| `onClose` (required) | `() => void` |  | Asked on Escape or a backdrop click. |
| `query` (required) | `string` |  | The search text (controlled). Filter the results from it. |
| `onQueryChange` (required) | `(query: string) => void` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | `<SearchGroup>`s and `<SearchResult>`s matching the query. |
| `empty` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown instead of the results when `children` is empty. |
| `preview` | `ReactNode` |  | Side panel (e.g. a preview of the highlighted result). |
| `status` | `ReactNode` |  | End of the footer, announced politely (e.g. "31 of 31"). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | "Search" | Input placeholder. |
| `label` | `string` | "Search" | Accessible name of the dialog and the input. |
| `navigateLabel` | `string` |  | Footer hint labels (translate here). |
| `selectLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `hints` | `boolean` | true | Show the keyboard hints footer. |

Plus all `<dialog>` attributes.

**SearchGroup**: A labelled group of `<SearchResult>`s inside a `<SearchDialog>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Small all-caps heading over the group; names it for assistive tech. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A modal dialog around a combobox: Up/Down move the active result, Enter opens it, Escape closes; the result count is announced through `status`.

```tsx
<SearchDialog open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} query={query} onQueryChange={setQuery} placeholder="Search components">
  <SearchGroup label="Components">
    <SearchResult onSelect={() => go("/button")}>Button</SearchResult>
  </SearchGroup>
</SearchDialog>
```

### SearchResult

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

One result in a `<SearchDialog>` (role="option"). The dialog's input keeps focus; arrow keys move the highlight here through aria-activedescendant, and the pointer moves it on hover.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Second line under the label. |
| `onSelect` | `() => void` |  | Runs on click, or on Enter while it is the highlighted result. |
| `onHighlight` | `() => void` |  | Runs when it becomes the highlighted result (keyboard or pointer). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Shown but never highlighted or selected. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=option inside the SearchDialog listbox; `onSelect` runs on Enter or click.

```tsx
<SearchResult icon={<Box />} description="Actions" onSelect={() => go("/button")}>Button</SearchResult>
```

### Sheet, SheetBody, SheetFooter

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**Sheet**: A panel sliding in from an edge, on the native `<dialog>` (showModal). It slides back out in CSS when closed. Compose with `<SheetBody>` (scrolls) and `<SheetFooter>` (pinned to the bottom).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. |
| `onClose` (required) | `() => void` |  | Asked on Escape, a backdrop click or the close button. |
| `side` | `"left" \| "right" \| "bottom"` | "right" | Edge it slides from. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Heading; also the dialog's accessible name. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Line under the title; wired as the accessible description. |
| `hideClose` | `boolean` |  | Hide the close button in the header. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | "Close" | Accessible name of the close button. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | true | Escape and backdrop clicks close it. |

Plus all `<dialog>` attributes.

**SheetBody**: Scrolling content area of a `<Sheet>`.

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**SheetFooter**: Action row pinned to the bottom of a `<Sheet>`, above a divider.

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Native `<dialog>` (modal) sliding from an edge: the page behind is inert, focus moves in and stays in, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger. `title` names it.

```tsx
<Sheet open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} side="right" title="Filters">
  <SheetBody>…</SheetBody>
</Sheet>
```

### Tooltip

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

A short hint on hover and keyboard focus (role="tooltip", wired with aria-describedby). A manual `popover` in the top layer, anchored to the trigger with CSS anchor positioning (or, where that is missing, placed from the trigger's box in JS); it fades in with a small offset and out again. Escape hides it; the pointer can move onto it without it closing.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The hint. Keep it short and non-interactive. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactElement<{ "aria-describedby"?: string }>` |  | The trigger: one focusable element (it gets aria-describedby). |
| `placement` | `"left" \| "right" \| "top" \| "bottom"` | "top" | Side of the trigger. |
| `openDelay` | `number` | 400 | Hover delay before showing, ms. |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | 100 | Delay before hiding once the pointer leaves, ms. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Never show (the trigger keeps working). |

Plus all `<span>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=tooltip, linked to its trigger with aria-describedby. Shows on hover and keyboard focus, Escape hides it. Never put essential information or controls inside; the trigger still needs its own name.

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard">
  <IconButton aria-label="Copy" icon={<Copy />} />
</Tooltip>
```

## Feedback

### Banner

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Full-width announcement bar. It fades in on mount; dismissing fades it and collapses its height to zero, then removes it and calls `onDismiss`. In a flex column or block flow the gap after it collapses too; a grid track cannot shrink below zero, so in a grid the row gap closes at the end.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"accent" \| "inverse" \| "subtle"` |  | `inverse` (default), `accent` or `subtle`. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon (e.g. `<Megaphone />`). |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  | Trailing link or button after the message. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` |  | Shows a close button; the banner collapses, then `onDismiss` runs. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | "Dismiss" | Close button label (translate here). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | "Announcement" | Region name (translate here). |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A region landmark: give it a distinct aria-label when several show. The dismiss button is labelled (`dismissLabel`).

```tsx
<Banner variant="accent" icon={<Megaphone />} dismissible>cherry 2.0 is here.</Banner>
```

### Callout

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Inline message box for supplementary, cautionary or critical notes. Static content (no live region); use a Toast for transient feedback. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"neutral" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info"` | `neutral` | Status color and default icon. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Bold first line. Optional. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode \| null` |  | Replaces the variant's icon; pass `null` for no icon. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** The icon is decorative: the title or text must state the tone (Warning, Error), not the color alone.

```tsx
<Callout variant="warning" title="Heads up">Back up your tokens before upgrading.</Callout>
```

### EmptyState

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Placeholder for an empty list, search with no results or a first run. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode \| null` | an inbox | Icon shown in a tile above the title. `null` hides it. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons or links under the text. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | 3 | Heading level of the title. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A heading (`headingLevel`) plus text; the icon is decorative.

```tsx
<EmptyState icon={<Inbox />} title="No projects yet" description="Create your first project." actions={<Button>New project</Button>} />
```

### Progress

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Linear progress bar (role="progressbar"). The fill eases to each new value; without a value it slides as an indeterminate loader. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | Current value. Omit (or pass null) for an indeterminate bar. |
| `max` | `number` | 100 |  |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label; also names the progressbar. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  | Shows the percentage next to the label. |
| `formatValue` | `(value: number, max: number) => string` | a rounded percentage | Formats the shown value. |
| `variant` | `"success" \| "danger" \| "default"` | `default` | Bar color. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` |  | Bar thickness: 4px (`sm`) or 6px (`md`, default). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Loading placeholder with a shimmer. Decorative (aria-hidden): mark the region that is loading with aria-busy instead. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `"text" \| "circle" \| "rect"` |  | `text` (lines), `circle` (avatar) or `rect` (media, cards). |
| `width` | `number \| string` | full width, circle to 40px | CSS width (number = px). Text |

Plus all `<span>` attributes.

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Spinning LoaderCircle (lucide geometry, inlined so no icon import is needed).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xs"` |  |  |

Plus all `<span>` attributes.

### Toaster

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Renders the toasts of the nearest `<ToastProvider>`. Place it once.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `"left" \| "right" \| "center"` | "center" | Horizontal placement. |
| `position` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | "top" | Anchored edge. |
| `expand` | `boolean` |  | Keep every toast fanned out instead of collapsing them into a deck. |
| `visibleToasts` | `number` | 3 | How many toasts show at once; older ones wait behind. |
| `label` | `string` | "Notifications" | Accessible name of the region. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | "Dismiss notification" | Accessible name of each close badge. |

Also exported: `ToastProvider`; `useToast` (Show, update and dismiss toasts from anywhere under `<ToastProvider>`).

**Accessibility:** Toasts are announced through a polite live region without moving focus; the close button is labelled (`dismissLabel`); Escape dismisses. Don't put the only copy of important actions in a toast.

```tsx
// Once, near the root:
<ToastProvider>
  {children}
  <Toaster />
</ToastProvider>

// Anywhere below:
const toast = useToast();
toast.show("Changes saved", { color: "success" });
```

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

Metric tile: label, value, a delta whose color follows the trend (and `inverse`), and an optional sparkline that draws itself in with a token gradient under it. No client JS.

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

A native `<table>` in a rounded, horizontally scrollable frame. Write plain thead / tbody / tr / th / td inside; mark number columns with `data-numeric` on their th and td to right-align them in tabular figures. Cells stay on one line so narrow screens scroll instead of squeezing columns; put `data-wrap` on a prose cell to let it wrap. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `frameStyle` | `CSSProperties` |  |  |

Plus all `<table>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A native table: use `<th>` headers (scope where needed). `scrollLabel` makes a table that can scroll sideways a named, keyboard-focusable region. Add `data-numeric` to number columns.

```tsx

  <thead><tr><th>Component</th><th data-numeric>Downloads</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td>Button</td><td data-numeric>12,840</td></tr></tbody>
</Table>
```

### Accordion, AccordionItem

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

**Accordion**: A stack of AccordionItems. No client JS: safe in Server Components.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"card" \| "inline"` | `card` | Applied to every item that does not set its own. |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` |  | `single` lets one item open at a time (items share a native `name`); `multiple` (default) lets any number open. |

| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**AccordionItem**: One disclosure built on native `<details>` / `<summary>`: keyboard, find-in-page and assistive tech work without client JS. Items sharing a `name` open one at a time (native exclusive accordion).

| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The always-visible heading (the `<summary>`). |

Plus all `<details>` attributes.

| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  | Stretch to the container width. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Stack**: A vertical Flex that does not wrap, with a 16px gap by default.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `Responsive<FlexDirection>` | "row" |  |
| `justify` | `Responsive<FlexJustify>` | "flex-start" |  |
| `align` | `Responsive<FlexAlign>` | "stretch" |  |
| `wrap` | `Responsive<FlexWrap>` | "wrap" (as in cherry 1 | x). |
| `gap` | `Responsive<SpaceStep>` | the gutter (20px, 40px from lg) | Gap as a spacing step. |
| `inline` | `boolean` |  | display: inline-flex. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  | Stretch to the container width. |

**Accessibility:** Layout only: no role. Keep the DOM order the reading order; don't reorder visually with `direction` in a way that breaks it.

```tsx
<Flex gap={3} align="center" wrap="wrap">…</Flex>
<Stack gap={4}>…</Stack>
```

### Grid, Col

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

**Grid**: CSS grid of equal columns. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cols` | `Responsive<number>` | 3 | Equal columns, per breakpoint. |
| `gap` | `Responsive<SpaceStep>` | the gutter (20px, 40px from lg) | Gap as a spacing step. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Col**: A grid cell that spans several columns. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `span` | `Responsive<ColSpan>` |  | Columns to span, per breakpoint; "full" spans the whole row. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Layout only: no role. Keep the DOM order the reading order.

```tsx
<Grid cols={{ xs: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }} gap={4}>
  <Col span={{ xs: 1, lg: 2 }}>…</Col>
</Grid>
```

## Chat

### ChatInput

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

Chat composer (Figma "ChatInput", 1.x chat-input): a growing text area, an action row and a round send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, an IME composition keeps Enter. With `glow` the border becomes a rotating AI gradient that brightens on hover and focus.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled text. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | Initial text when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onSend` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Enter (or the send button) with non-blank text. Uncontrolled input clears after. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | A reply is on its way: the send button spins and sending is blocked. |
| `glow` | `boolean` |  | Animated AI gradient border with a soft halo. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Controls at the start of the footer (attach, tools...), e.g. IconButtons. |
| `footnote` | `ReactNode` |  | Small print under the composer ("AI can make mistakes."). |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | 160 | Tallest the text area grows before it scrolls, in px. |
| `sendLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` |  |  |

Plus all `<textarea>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** The textarea is labelled ("Message" by default, override with aria-label): Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; the send button is labelled (`sendLabel`).

```tsx
<ChatInput onSend={send} loading={pending} footnote="AI can make mistakes." />
```

### ChatMessage

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

One chat turn. Messages animate in (the user bubble grows from its corner, the reply rises and its avatar pops), then the action row fades in. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `role` | `"user" \| "assistant"` | "assistant" | user: a right-aligned bubble; assistant: a full-width reply. |
| `avatar` | `ReactNode` |  | Beside the message, typically an `<Avatar size="sm">`. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Row under the message (copy, retry...), typically small IconButtons. |
| `streaming` | `boolean` |  | Shows a blinking caret after the text while a reply streams in. |
| `still` | `boolean` |  | Skip the entrance animation (messages restored from history). |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** Messages sit in the ChatMessageList log; a `streaming` reply is aria-busy until it finishes.

```tsx
<ChatMessage role="user">How do I add a brand color?</ChatMessage>
<ChatMessage role="assistant" streaming={pending}>{reply}</ChatMessage>
```

### ChatPanel, ChatMessageList, ChatLauncher

_Client component (`"use client"`): import it from a Server Component freely; it hydrates on the client._

**ChatPanel**: The assistant's window (Figma "ChatPanel"). Overlay variants are a native `<dialog>`: Escape, the top layer, inert background and the backdrop come from the platform; CSS animates the slide or fade both ways (@starting-style + allow-discrete). On open, focus goes to the composer.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"inline" \| "drawer" \| "fullscreen"` | "drawer" | drawer: slides in from the side (modal below 992px, beside the page above it); fullscreen: covers the viewport, modal; inline: a plain panel in the page flow. |
| `side` | `"left" \| "right"` | "right" | Drawer edge. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Overlay variants: shown or not. Inline panels ignore it. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with false when Escape or the close button asks to close. |
| `modal` | `boolean` |  | Force modal (true) or non-modal (false) instead of the variant default. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | "AI assistant" | Header title. null hides the header text. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | sparkles | Header icon. null hides it. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Extra header controls (reset...), before the close button. |
| `hideClose` | `boolean` |  | Hide the close button of an overlay panel. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` |  |  |

Plus all `<element>` attributes.

**ChatMessageList**: Scrolling transcript (role="log"). It follows new messages while the reader is near the bottom (smoothly, or instantly while streaming or with reduced motion) and stops following once they scroll up.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `streaming` | `boolean` |  | A reply is streaming: following jumps instead of smooth-scrolling, and turning it on re-arms following. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**ChatLauncher**: Compact "Ask AI" button that opens the panel (pass aria-expanded).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `glow` | `boolean` |  | Animated AI gradient border with a soft halo. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | sparkles | Icon before the label. |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** The drawer is a modal dialog (`title` names it); the transcript (ChatMessageList) is a live log; Escape closes and focus returns to the ChatLauncher.

```tsx
<ChatLauncher onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}>Ask AI</ChatLauncher>
<ChatPanel variant="drawer" open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen} title="Assistant">
  <ChatMessageList>{messages}</ChatMessageList>
  <ChatInput onSend={send} />
</ChatPanel>
```

### ChatSources, ChatSource

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

**ChatSources**: Numbered list of sources under a reply. Chips fade in one after another.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | "Sources" | Names the list for assistive tech. |

Plus all `<ol>` attributes.

**ChatSource**: One source chip: a link with its number in a circle (a CSS counter, so the order is the list order).

Plus all `<a>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A labelled list (`label`) of source links; each chip's text names its source.

```tsx
<ChatSources>
  <ChatSource href="/docs/theming">Theming</ChatSource>
</ChatSources>
```

### ChatSuggestions, ChatSuggestion

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

**ChatSuggestions**: Row of suggested prompts. Chips fade in one after another.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | "Suggestions" | Names the group for assistive tech. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**ChatSuggestion**: A suggested prompt chip. Wire onClick to send its text.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the text. |

Plus all `<button>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** A labelled group (`label`) of buttons; each suggestion's text is its name.

```tsx
<ChatSuggestions>
  <ChatSuggestion onClick={() => ask("How do I add a brand?")}>How do I add a brand?</ChatSuggestion>
</ChatSuggestions>
```

### ChatTyping

_Server Component safe: no client JavaScript._

"The assistant is answering": three bouncing dots and a label. No client JS.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | "Thinking…" | Text after the dots. |
| `active` | `boolean` | true | Keep it mounted and toggle this to let it fade and fold away (and back) instead of popping out. |

Plus all `<div>` attributes.

**Accessibility:** role=status: "typing" is announced while `active`.

```tsx
<ChatTyping active={pending} />
```
